serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: You: !{{punch}} Landlord: … How did he appear behind me so quickly?! He’s been a few dozen feet further down the hall! Scary! Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: He took the bait! Now just say your goodbyes and try acting natural! You: S-Sorry mom, I need to hang up. Someone is staring at me… Landlord: … Landlord: So. {{wi}}Your mom. {{wi}}She’s one of them. You: Well… Landlord: Oh! Of course I don’t mean anything bad! Sure, maybe IRS agents never done a day of honest work, but they are still human, right~ Landlord: Just joking, joking~! Landlord: Listen. How about we help each other. How about that? You: What do you mean? Landlord: You see, instead of working against all these governmental para- I mean, institutions, I want to work with them! Help eachother! You know what I mean? You: Sure… Landlord: So how about this? As a sign of good faith, I will lower your rent by the amount of those late payment penalties you gathered and in exchange…{{wi}} you talk to your mom, tell her a few good things about me. Landlord: Do we have a deal? You: Sure… Landlord: Let’s shake hands on it! W-We, we did it! My grin is almost showing, but I need to hold it in!
